patterns.note: A responsive, masonry-like grid displays diverse project showcases, each featuring an image, title, and 'View' link, creating a visually rich gallery.

A consistent, clean sans-serif is used for all UI elements (navigation, body text, footer), providing a neutral backdrop for the highly varied and expressive display typefaces showcased within the content modules.

The UI employs a high-contrast black and white palette, accented by a single vibrant green for interactive elements like buttons and scroll indicators, allowing the colorful content images to stand out.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, ensuring persistent access to site links.
A dark, multi-column footer provides comprehensive site navigation and information, featuring a unique animated scroll-to-top/bottom indicator.

technique_notes: The site employs a standard scroll behavior for content, with no complex scroll-triggered animations for revealing sections or parallax effects. The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport to provide persistent access.
Content is presented in a flexible grid system that adapts to various screen sizes, maintaining consistent spacing around each project showcase to create a clean, gallery-like presentation.

A high-contrast color scheme for the user interface (black text on white backgrounds, white text on black footer) is used to create a stark, legible foundation, with a single bright accent color drawing attention to key interactive elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Clean, legible sans-serif for UI elements with a moderate hierarchy, while display typefaces within content modules vary wildly in size and weight to showcase their character.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp for most elements, with subtle rounding applied only to interactive elements like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, characterized by generous and consistent gutters within the content grid.

standout: The site's distinctive quality is its direct and unadorned presentation of diverse typefaces, using a clean, high-contrast UI as a neutral canvas. The content itself (the typeface showcases) provides all the visual richness and variety, making the site feel like a curated gallery rather than a typical marketing page.
